descriptor.name: Allegheny County parcel boundaries
descriptor.licenceNote: County-published regional catalogue specifies no licence; reuse rights require separate primary review.
descriptor.scope: Allegheny County parcel-boundary layer including Pittsburgh. Qualification is bounded around the frozen WUP point and does not establish citywide completeness, legal title, survey accuracy or currentness. Native CRS EPSG:2272 / WKID 102729; queries request WGS84 GeoJSON outSR=4326.

evidence: Frozen city-8067-pittsburgh.json registry.sourceScope and geometry.nativeIdentity identify the Allegheny County public parcel-boundary layer including Pittsburgh; pittsburgh-service-review.json officialPrimarySources and geometryDecision bind PIN 0013G00229000000 to an anonymous polygon query at the unchanged WUP point. The frozen sample SHA-256 matches the queue.

The Allegheny County publisher describes the dataset as boundaries of individual parcels across the county, with block and lot identifiers, in https://data.wprdc.org/dataset/allegheny-county-parcel-boundaries1. The live county endpoint https://gisdata.alleghenycounty.us/arcgis/rest/services/OPENDATA/Parcels/MapServer identifies the DCS-GIS custodian and public parcel purpose; layer 0 exposes polygon geometry and string PIN identity. Safe metadata, a short exact purpose excerpt, schema and download-link inspection are retained in evidence/official-source-inspection.json.

The frozen service review documents official Pittsburgh GIS discovery and county scope. An independent bounded live query at [-79.9703261647027,40.4196878479719] returned the same PIN 0013G00229000000 and polygon geometry with only PIN and OBJECTID requested. This confirms a parcel at the Pittsburgh locator; it is not a citywide coverage assertion.
